primary_route: Proposed target-cell somatic calcium-imaging calibration against paired electrophysiology, structural 3D motion reference, neuropil/expression sensitivity and visual-response validation.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior paired-imaging/electrophysiology Methods, supplements or validated protocols to choose conditions and verify transfer.

No concrete indicator expression/preparation route, delivered quantity or procedure deriving those values; acquisition variables are listed but no executable preparation sequence sets the underlying biological material.

Response classification/tuning comparisons have no specified statistical test or multiplicity family/control. Hierarchical uncertainty for detection metrics does not define these multiple visual-response claims.
No bounded neuropil coefficient/geometry exploration or explicit procedure deriving its bounds, evaluation grid and stop before selecting the frozen model.
Preservation is promised, but no complete stable preparation/cell/trial linkage and exact acquisition, processing, code/environment/model versions sufficient to rerun the result.

Confidence-bound acceptance, failure-driven claim restriction and fresh held-out validation are clear; soma ground truth is not overextended to spine events.
